label: Kestrel Brake Works twin
info: Runs the Kestrel Brake Works digital twin simulation and publishes it to the Industrial Edge Databus as SIMATIC v1 JSON. See /docs/#/industrial-edge in the twin app.

name: Read me: Databus credentials, connector name and topics
info:
1. Open the "IE Databus" broker node and enter the user name and password of a Databus user that may publish and subscribe to ie/#.
2. The connector name is "kestreltwin1". To change it, edit CONNECTOR in the function node and the topic of the "Writes" MQTT-in node.
3. Data: ie/d/j/simatic/v1/kestreltwin1/dp/r/factory/<chunk>. Metadata: ie/m/j/simatic/v1/kestreltwin1/dp (retained).
4. Writes: ie/d/j/simatic/v1/kestreltwin1/dp/w/factory/Control_0 (commands) and AI_0 (AI Inference Server results). Both are echoed on the read topic.
5. The simulation state is kept in flow context "kestrelWorld". Delete it to start a new shift.
